title: fix(agent): raise the bridge request body limit above 1 MiB

files.patch:
@@ -69,6 +69,10 @@
 #: CLIs like Hermes may request very large values derived from context_length.
 _MAX_OPENAI_MAX_TOKENS_CAP = 16384
 
+#: Request body limit of the bridge. Agent requests carry the whole history, tool
+#: output and base64 images, which easily exceeds aiohttp's 1 MiB default.
+_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024
+
 #: Env names whose runtime is a Docker container — for these we rewrite
 #: the bridge's loopback host to ``host.docker.internal`` so the agent
 #: inside the container can reach the bridge on the host. Shared with
@@ -252,7 +256,7 @@ async def _start_server(self) -> None:
         if self._phase is not _ProxyPhase.STARTING:
             raise _ProxyClosingError('ModelProxyServer is shutting down.')
 
-        app = web.Application()
+        app = web.Application(client_max_size=_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES)
         app.router.add_post('/anthropic/v1/messages', self._handle_anthropic_messages)
         app.router.add_post('/openai/v1/chat/completions', self._handle_openai_chat_completions)
         app.router.add_post('/openai/v1/responses', self._handle_openai_responses)

@@ -134,6 +134,22 @@ def _request():
     assert set(body['usage']) == {'prompt_tokens', 'completion_tokens', 'total_tokens'}
 
 
+def test_openai_chat_accepts_request_body_over_one_mib():
+    """Long agent histories exceed aiohttp's 1 MiB default body limit."""
+    expected = 'hello from mock'
+
+    async def _go():
+        proxy = await ModelProxyServer.get_or_start()
+        model = _build_model(_text_output(expected))
+        async with proxy.trial_session(model=model, framework='mock') as session:
+            url = f'{proxy.base_url}/openai/v1/chat/completions'
+            payload = {'model': 'mock-openai', 'messages': [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'a' * (2 * 1024 * 1024)}]}
+            return await asyncio.get_running_loop().run_in_executor(None, _post_json, url, payload, session.token)
+
+    body = AsyncioLoopRunner.run(_go())
+    assert body['choices'][0]['message']['content'] == expected
+
+
 def test_openai_chat_completion_reasoning_content_json():
     """reasoning_content from a ContentReasoning block appears alongside content."""
